hero.title: See what's happening. Verify before anyone else.
hero.subtitle: Aegis Lens aggregates, verifies and visualizes real-time conflict, infrastructure and geopolitical intelligence — starting with Ukraine, scaling globally.
how.title: How it works
how.step1_body: Public sources — Telegram, satellite, AIS, ADS-B, news — normalized into one canonical event stream.
how.step2_body: AI summarization with citations. Cross-source corroboration. Human-in-the-loop on high-impact events.
how.step3_body: Cinematic map with 15+ layers, timeline scrubbing, AI copilot, and a permalink for every event.
personas.title: Built for the people who need it
newsletter.title: Stay ahead of events
newsletter.body: Verified intelligence digests — daily or weekly, by region or topic. No noise.
